semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in ultra-precision motion platforms and components used in various semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Albert (Suzhou) Technology Co., Ltd. is a high-tech company that develops and manufactures ultra-precision motion platforms and components essential for semiconductor applications. Their products are utilized in critical processes such as lithography, wafer inspection, and high-precision packaging.

regional_presence.China: The company operates a precision motion platform R&D and manufacturing center in Suzhou, covering an area of 13,000 square meters.
